description: handle_email_set update loop (line 994) uses args.get("update").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) (borrow), making patch_val: &Value throughout. This forces patch_val.clone() at line 1011 for update_object. The function takes args: Value by ownership and could use args.remove("update") or entry-based consumption to avoid the clone. Not covered by JMAP-4ii.53 (chat.rs/identity.rs), JMAP-4ii.26 (mailbox), or JMAP-4ii.59 (onSuccessUpdateEmail).
title: email.rs update loop borrow forces patch_val.clone()
